boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations in Loyola’s Lake Shore campus orbit, each tied to its nearby corridor and a specific documented reason to go.

cards.title: Eggs with Benefits
cards.subtitle: Sheridan Road corridor — 6441 N. Sheridan Rd.
cards.notes: Walk north along Sheridan Road to the listed 6441 N. Sheridan address for the Korean-inspired breakfast spot and its tacos.
cards.short_summary: A documented Sheridan Road breakfast-and-taco stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Eggs with Benefits at 6441 N. Sheridan Road and describes it as a Korean-inspired breakfast place that also sells tacos.
cards.access_notes: Listed by Loyola as a Lake Shore Campus neighborhood dining destination.

cards.title: Honeybear Cafe
cards.subtitle: Clark Street corridor — 7036 N. Clark St.
cards.notes: Follow the Clark Street corridor to the listed 7036 N. Clark address when a brunch stop and its colorful decor fit the plan.
cards.short_summary: A Clark Street brunch destination listed by the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Honeybear at 7036 N. Clark Street as a brunch spot with creative menu items and colorful decor.
cards.access_notes: Listed by Loyola as a Lake Shore Campus neighborhood dining destination.

cards.title: J.B. Alberto's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Morse Avenue corridor — 1326 W. Morse Ave.
cards.notes: Head to the listed Morse Avenue address for a pizza stop; Loyola specifically notes that pizza is available by the slice.
cards.short_summary: A Morse Avenue pizza destination with slices available.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists J.B. Alberto's at 1326 W. Morse Avenue and states that the long-standing pizza spot sells pizza by the slice.
cards.access_notes: Listed by Loyola as a Lake Shore Campus neighborhood dining destination.

cards.title: Metropolis Coffee Company
cards.subtitle: Granville Avenue corridor — 1039 W. Granville Ave.
cards.notes: Use Granville Avenue to reach the listed café and coffee roaster for a coffee break or a sit-down between neighborhood errands.
cards.short_summary: A Granville Avenue café and local coffee roaster.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Metropolis Coffee Company at 1039 W. Granville Avenue as a specialty local coffee roaster and café.
cards.access_notes: Listed by Loyola as a Lake Shore Campus neighborhood dining destination.

cards.title: Sam's Chicken & Ribs
cards.subtitle: Granville Avenue corridor — 1102 W. Granville Ave.
cards.notes: Continue along Granville Avenue to the listed 1102 W. Granville address for the casual menu of ribs, chicken, hot dogs, gyros, and more.
cards.short_summary: A casual Granville Avenue comfort-food stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Sam's Chicken & Ribs at 1102 W. Granville Avenue and describes its menu as including ribs, fried chicken, hot dogs, and gyros.
cards.access_notes: Listed by Loyola as a Lake Shore Campus neighborhood dining destination.

cards.title: Waterfront Cafe
cards.subtitle: Sheridan Road corridor — 6219 N. Sheridan Rd.
cards.notes: Take Sheridan Road to the listed seasonal café when it is operating in warmer months; its outdoor patio faces Lake Michigan.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal Sheridan Road café with a lake-facing patio.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Waterfront Cafe at 6219 N. Sheridan Road as a seasonal warm-weather café with an outdoor patio overlooking Lake Michigan.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal; Loyola states that it operates in the warmer months.

cards.title: Loyola Beach
cards.subtitle: Sheridan Road corridor — 1230 W. Sheridan Rd.
cards.notes: Use the Sheridan Road approach for beach access and the long walking trail, then pause by the Lake Michigan shoreline.
cards.short_summary: A Lake Michigan shoreline destination with a walking trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Loyola Beach at 1230 W. Sheridan Road and describes beach access, a long walking trail, and a Lake Michigan shoreline setting.
cards.access_notes: Loyola lists it as a Lake Shore Campus neighborhood place to experience.

cards.title: Armadillo's Pillow
cards.subtitle: Sheridan Road corridor — 1230 W. Sheridan Rd.
cards.notes: Stop along Sheridan Road to browse the listed used bookstore’s stacks of books and eclectic products at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A used-book browsing stop on the Sheridan Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Armadillo's Pillow at 1230 W. Sheridan Road as a used bookstore with stacks of books and eclectic products.
cards.access_notes: Loyola lists it as a Lake Shore Campus neighborhood place to experience.

cards.title: Dice Dojo
cards.subtitle: Sheridan Road corridor — 1230 W. Sheridan Rd.
cards.notes: Use the Sheridan Road corridor to reach the named tabletop shop for browsing board games, role-playing games, and card games.
cards.short_summary: A tabletop-game shop for browsing and play.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Dice Dojo at 1230 W. Sheridan Road as a tabletop gaming shop where visitors can browse, buy, and play board games, RPGs, and card games.
cards.access_notes: Loyola lists it as a Lake Shore Campus neighborhood place to experience.

cards.title: Devon / Little India
cards.subtitle: Devon Avenue corridor — between N. Western Ave. and N. California Ave.
cards.notes: Plan a Devon Avenue walk between Western and California to explore the documented South Asian shops, restaurants, and markets.
cards.short_summary: A named cultural corridor for South Asian shops and food.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies Devon / Little India as a cultural corridor on Devon Avenue between Western and California, known for South Asian shops, restaurants, and markets.
cards.access_notes: Loyola describes this corridor as a few minutes from campus.
